scope: Matched-padded single-pass MaskGIT controls; independent namespace, future inference only
input_derivation: Read actual attempt-one packet receptions and CRC flags from locked padded ARQ traces; restore token IDs and both masks to original image coordinates. Derivation adds no physical simulation.
metric_conventions: same raw PSNR, clamped normalized LPIPS and clipped PIL CLIP as primary; separate development cohort
input_output: demo x in [0,1] -> raw decode y
reuse_rule: Direct and ideal references may be reused only with exact final-ID, image, weight, metric convention and source-case identity. New oracle/CRC generated endpoints are never copied from the old unpadded random study.
resources: All single-pass padded paths use 64*26=1664 forward symbols; compare with actual same-framing CRC/oracle ARQ endpoints. Perfect supplied class information and unmodeled feedback/headers/CMI airtime remain explicit.
aggregation: Only complete 50-frame SNR groups for all six paths may be compared against the same 50 padded ARQ frames; five trials within image then ten images; preserve all masks, class modes and paired image differences.
